earnings.title: Ferguson Reports Third Quarter Ended September 30, 2026
highlights: Diluted earnings per share of $3.08, down 4.9% from prior year ( $3.43 on an adjusted basis, up 7.9% ).
Sales of $9.0 billion, increased 9.5%, including 7.0% organic growth.
Gross margin of 30.9%, down 40 bps from prior year.
Operating margin of 9.8%, down 40 bps from prior year (10.7% on an adjusted basis, flat with prior year).

items.heading: Weakness in the economy, market trends, uncertainty and other conditions in the markets in which we operate, particularly in the U.S., have in the past and may in the future adversely affect the profitability and financial stability of some of our customers and vendors, and, in turn, negatively impact our business, financial condition and results of operations.
We have in the past and may in the future be adversely impacted by declines in the residential and non-residential markets.

The industries in which we operate are highly competitive, and changes in competition could result in decreased demand for our products and related service offerings and could have a material adverse effect on our sales and profitability.
Fluctuating product prices have in the past and may in the future adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
We have funding risks related to our defined benefit pension plans.
Changes in our credit ratings and outlook may reduce access to capital and increase borrowing costs.
